title: Natural invertible computation of the actual pulled reduction tower
statement: Let l be prime, E/Q_l finite, and h:U to T arbitrary. Scalar restriction along integralDetailedCoefficientComparison U l E is an equivalence. The literal actual tower counit is invertible on every flat-term K-flat representative. On all complexes these counits form a natural transformation from Q followed by detailed coefficient transport, derived reduction, and derived tower pullback, to the literal actual tower functor followed by Q. The published coefficient and counit data are those of [def-weil-pbc-proper-integral-ordinary-data], and the explicit actual tower functor is recorded in [lem-weil-pbc-integral-strict-model-chain-transport].

proof.text: Lift the normalized coefficient comparison to its unique ring-sheaf isomorphism. Restriction along it is an equivalence and preserves K-flatness. Apply the existing reduction-tower counit computation. The completed coefficient inverse-image map is an isomorphism, hence ordinary tower pullback is exact and its derived counit is invertible on every complex. Compose these two counits and the exact scalar transport factor; the three naturality squares compose to the desired natural transformation, with the literal actual-tower counit as its component. This proves invertibility on good complexes.

theorem pbc_integral_actual_tower_computation
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] {U T : Scheme.{u}} (h : U ⟶ T) :
    (pbcIntegralTransportModules U l E).IsEquivalence ∧
    (∀ P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E T).FullSubcategory,
      IsIso (pbcIntegralActualTowerCounit l E h P.obj)) ∧
    ∃ c : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ integralDetailedTransport T l E ⋙
        completedReductionTower T (pbcIntegralDatum l E) ⋙
          completedTowerPullback h (pbcIntegralDatum l E) ⟶
        pbcIntegralActualTowerFunctor l E h ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q,
      ∀ P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E T) ℤ,
        c.app P = pbcIntegralActualTowerCounit l E h P
